page_title: LIV 4-2 NEW | Liverpool v Newcastle 01/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
90+6' The resulting corner, taken by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), comes to nothing.

90+5' Diogo Jota (Liverpool) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Liverpool.
90+5' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) makes space for himself in the box after some nice work, but his shot is immediately charged down by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' What was Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
86' 4 - 2 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Martin Dubravka no chance!
86' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is going to take the penalty!
86' Referee Anthony Taylor is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Liverpool!
85' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Liverpool as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
84' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) is shown a yellow card by the referee.
84' Martin Dubravka (Newcastle Utd) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. That is a penalty kick for Liverpool.
82' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jamaal Lascelles (Newcastle Utd) replacing Joelinton.
82' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dan Burn walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lewis Hall (Newcastle Utd).
81' 3 - 2 The score has changed – 3:2. Sean Longstaff sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) jumps highest and plants a header down inside the left post.
81' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) will take the corner.

81' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out for a corner. Newcastle can continue in their attacking effort.
80' Anthony Taylor sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
80' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
78' 3 - 1 Goal! Mohamed Salah puts a cross into the box and finds Cody Gakpo (Liverpool), who latches on to it and strikes the ball into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:1.

76' A fine solo run by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Liverpool will have a goal kick.
75' The substitution has been made. Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) has replaced Wataru Endo.
74' 2 - 1 Goal! Diogo Jota puts the ball across the area and Curtis Jones (Liverpool) has the easiest task in the world to tuck the ball into an empty net. 2:1.
73' Wonderful movement by Liverpool. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
70' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

69' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Martin Dubravka pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going low into the middle of the target.
69' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
69' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Liverpool force a corner. They send men into the box.
66' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
65' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
65' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
65' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) causes Martin Dubravka little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
64' That will be all from Darwin Nunez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
64' Jurgen Klopp prepares a substitution. Luis Diaz is replaced by Diogo Jota (Liverpool).
64' A substitution has been made. Dominik Szoboszlai is replaced by Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool).

64' What an opportunity! Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.

63' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the roof of the net, but Martin Dubravka thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
62' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
61' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
59' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
57' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
54' 1 - 1 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lewis Miley departs the field of play to be replaced by Miguel Almiron (Newcastle Utd).
53' A dangerous looking corner kick from Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is cleared to safety by the defence.
53' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Martin Dubravka is alert and denies him with a nice save.

52' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

52' What a wasted opportunity by Mohamed Salah (Liverpool)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the middle of the net, but Martin Dubravka makes a comfortable save to thwart him.
49' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Darwin Nunez plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Mohamed Salah (Liverpool). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.

48' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
47' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
45+4' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Martin Dubravka, who smothers the ball.
45+2' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
45+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) is booked.
44' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
44' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) works the corner short.
43' A long through ball into the box almost gives Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
41' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 17:1.
39' OFF THE POST! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) meets a lofted pass and immediately produces a snap shot from the edge of the 18-yard box, but his bullet of a strike rattles the right post.
38' The goal by Newcastle won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
37' Attention! Referee Anthony Taylor straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
36' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Dan Burn (Newcastle Utd) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
36' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) goes on a mazy run and neatly slips through the defence. However, he fails in the final task - beating the goalkeeper, as Martin Dubravka is alert enough to deny him.
31' Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
29' The free kick is taken by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), but ball is cleared.
28' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
26' Liverpool take a short corner kick.

26' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The referee blows his whistle, Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
26' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) prepares to take a corner kick.
26' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.

24' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) collects a rebound a long way out and doesn't hesitate to release a goal-bound hammer of a shot. His attempt is precise and low towards the middle of the target. It would have ended in the back of the net if it wasn't for Martin Dubravka and his nice save.
23' Unbelievable miss! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) reacts superbly to latch on to a rebound, but he blazes the ball high over the crossbar!
22' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the middle of the target, but Martin Dubravka pulls off a save.
22' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
22' Referee Anthony Taylor is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Liverpool!
22' Celebrations by Liverpool are cut short as the referee signals that the penalty decision will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully it won’t take too long.
21' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Liverpool are awarded a penalty kick!
20' Celebrations are cut short for Liverpool as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
19' The Liverpool players joy may have been justified, because referee Anthony Taylor is going use VAR to determine whether it was offside.
18' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) has a goal ruled out for offside!
17' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header which goes well over the bar.

16' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Anthony Taylor stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Free kick. Liverpool will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
13' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
13' A fine pass finds Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Martin Dubravka reacts superbly to deny him.
11' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings in a cross from the corner, but Martin Dubravka reads it well and gathers the ball.
11' Good clearance! Joe Gomez (Liverpool) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Liverpool have a corner.
10' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
9' The resulting corner comes to nothing as Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd) sends it out of play.

8' Lewis Miley (Newcastle Utd) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Newcastle.
7' Anthony Taylor blows the whistle, Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul.
6' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Martin Dubravka.
6' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd). Anthony Taylor saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
4' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
4' Anthony Taylor couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) and blew his whistle. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
3' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

2' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Liverpool will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
Show lineups
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
